title: D-form harness request (input.json)
description: Wire contract for input.json as written by backend CodeExecutionHelperImpl.buildDBatchInputsJson and consumed by the per-language harnesses (java, python, cpp).

per_case_timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock budget per case in milliseconds. Harness enforces via subprocess / future / fork+waitpid timeout; a runaway case becomes Time Limit Exceeded.

memory_limit_bytes.description: Per-run heap ceiling forwarded to each case. 0 / absent disables the harness-level MLE check (Docker cgroup is the Layer-B backstop).

method_name.description: Solution method to invoke when Solution exposes multiple public methods.

cases.description: Test cases. Order preserved: cases[i] -> results[i].

label.description: Human-readable label. Defaults to case_id when absent.

expected_output.description: JSON-encoded literal of the expected return value. The harness parses it before comparison.

inputs.description: Per-argument input specs. Positional, matching Solution method signature.

value.description: JSON-encoded literal. Backend always ships it as a string (e.g. "[1,2,3]"); harness parses it.

type.description: OJ type hint from DFORM_TYPES. When set, takes precedence over the method's signature annotation.
